dossier.summary: Oakline Foods bakes and packs bread and snacks for grocery chains from three plants.

rows.label: Plant operations
rows.detail: Records line stoppages and changeovers in the platform instead of on whiteboards.

rows.label: Quality assurance
rows.detail: Closes deviation reports in the platform, with the batch record attached.

rows.label: Procurement
rows.detail: Matches supplier invoices to purchase orders in one queue.

rows.label: Supply planning
rows.detail: Reviews stock exceptions each morning from one list.

rows.label: Finance
rows.detail: Uses the platform for month-end accruals only.

rows.label: Customer service
rows.detail: Answers order status questions from the shared board.

rows.label: Q3 planning call
rows.detail: 45 minutes to agree the Q3 targets.

rows.label: Finance onboarding
rows.detail: Two sessions to bring the 22 unused finance seats into use.

data.headline: Oakline Foods saved 4,265 hours in Q2, 37 percent more than in Q1, with 311 of 400 seats active.
data.usage_note: Active seats grew from 140 in October to 311 in June, and grew every month.
data.adoption_note: Quality assurance has 62 of 70 seats active and Plant operations 118 of 140. Finance has 28 of 50 and Customer service 24 of 35.

plan.what: Agree the Q3 targets on a 45-minute call.
